# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The uploaded corpus is very large, but the overwhelming majority of recordings are **not usable sales conversations** — they are internal operations chatter (MTC/tag/test-certificate exchanges, e-way bill and billing-address corrections, driver/crane/loading coordination, payment-reconciliation calls with transporters like "Dushyan bhai"), voicemails, wrong numbers, or long personal/non-business conversations (the "Vishal" and "Yuvraj Operator" threads are almost entirely cutting-floor coordination or personal chit-chat, not customer sales talk). After filtering these out, the **genuine sales-relevant calls** are a comparatively small, scattered set — mostly short rate-enquiry calls, price-negotiation snippets, and a few recurring dealer/contractor relationships (V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, V SRIDHAR/Sivakesava Engineers, Vidveda/Krishnasamy, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, Venkatesan, Uniqcore Const, Vanniar Narendrakumar/Aster, Zetwork Harish, Yasar Feroz Godown, VJR Developers). Given this, the knowledge base below is built strictly from what is actually said in these calls, and stays honest about being a thin, fragmented sample rather than a deep set of structured sales dialogues.

## Products & brand ladder
From the real sales calls, BSC trades in **long and flat MS/structural steel products**, sourced from major mills and sold under mill names and the "sale" (resale/distributor-stock) category:

- **TMT rebar**: grades FE 500/500D/550D. "500 kidaikathu sir... avanga ippa R&L production illa" [500-grade isn't available now, RINL isn't producing it] — so 550D/500D are what's actually movable. CRS (corrosion-resistant steel) TMT also sold: "sale TMT 500D thaan varum sir CRS-la" [only 500D comes in CRS under 'sale']; 550 not manufactured in CRS.
- **Structural steel**: ISMB (I-beams), ISMC/channel, ISA (angles), SHS/square & rectangular pipes — but BSC explicitly does **not** deal in SHS/tube/pipe: "SHS namma deal pandrathu illai sir... Only ISMB plate" (Varadharajulu/Vasudevan call), and "pipes namma deal pandrathu illai" (Velarasu call).
- **MS Plates / checkered plates**: thickness range 2mm–25mm+, standard widths 4ft/2500mm and 8ft, standard length 6300mm ("full-aave 6300 thaan 2500 6300 thaan sir... stop"). Thinner coil-cut plates (2–3mm) made to order from coil.
- **MS Flats**: various sizes (e.g., 50x5, 100x5/6) quoted per piece/length.
- **Brands cited**: Tata Steel, SAIL ("Sale"/"சைல்"), JSW, Vizag/RINL (Visakhapatnam Steel/RINL), Vaisakh. Vaisakh and Sale are treated as same price tier: "Vaisakh-kum sale-kum rate different irukkaa? Rate different irukkaathu sir rendume same price thaan."
- Customers frequently ask specifically for **Tata** material citing better consistency/price, forcing the rep to explain Tata availability constraints (single distributor, stock gaps in certain thickness like 2.5mm pipe).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- **Structural/pipe (Uniqcore)**: "₹78 potturukkenga, etavathu kuraiya mudiyuma?" — base quote ₹78; cycle/local brands cheaper than Tata but buyer insists on Tata; thickness substitution offered (2.5mm unavailable, 2.6/2.9mm offered instead).
- **ISMB/Channel (V R Earth Movers, Aug)**: ₹61/kg quoted, compared against "Tata Steel ₹60" the customer claims; rep clarifies ISMB item cost is higher; sheet 1500×8mm priced at ₹59,500 flat (~₹39.6/kg equivalent for that SKU).
- **V R Earth Movers (Aug 31)**: quotation revised "+₹2000" from old rate; comparing 300×150 vs 300×140 channel — "300/150 ₹60/kg, 300/140 ₹63/kg" due to weight/flange difference (42kg/m vs 46kg/m).
- **V R Earth Movers (Oct)**: 20-ton sheet enquiry, quoted **₹65.5/kg** (up from ~₹58–59 "last month"); grade E250 confirmed, E350 would add **+₹3000**.
- **Vinayaga Steel Pradeep (Aug–Oct)**: plate market rate moved **₹59.5k → ₹61–65/kg** range over weeks; checkered/MS plate 4mm/5mm 4x8 quoted **₹64**, negotiated down to **₹63.5**; another call cites **₹62** for 16mm plate (4x20); coil-cut option for odd sizes at **₹20.10/unit-length pricing** style.
- **V Kumar (flat, 18ft/5.5m)**: opening ask ₹54/kg, rep floor price final **₹53.5/kg + GST + loading + transport extra**; customer wanted regularization to a past ₹50-50 rate — refused as "அவ்ளோ கம்மி நம்மளால கண்டிப்பா பண்ண முடியாது."
- **Vanniar Narendrakumar (CRS 20mm sale)**: **₹69,000/ton** (≈₹69/kg) "including, plus loading extra" but loading offered free for this buyer; only this one CRS item in stock, no Vizag CRS available.
- **Vimalkumar/Saveetha Institute (TMT, 40 tons)**: 12mm **₹69/kg**, 16mm **₹68.5/kg**, "GST extra" (not inclusive); no discount on 12mm, ₹0.5/kg relief on 16mm only.
- **VJR Developers (Vizag, Sriperumbudur delivery)**: 16/20/25mm **₹65k/ton**, 12mm **₹67k**, 10mm **₹68–69k**, 8mm **₹70k**; delivery transport **+₹500/ton** extra over ex-works.
- **Vijaya Steels Vizag/Chennai comparison**: Chennai base ₹63.5–64/ton-equivalent cited vs local ₹65 "already giving," negotiated toward **₹63.5** for bulk.
- **Vidveda Krishnasamy**: "25 sale illa-nu sollitu Vizag koduthurukku... Vizag is not approved" at that site — brand approval matters as much as price; credit terms "1 month" available for repeat orders, else advance payment required.
- **Zetwork Harish**: large-ton enquiries (120 tons+), rate revised **down ₹500** mid-negotiation (₹64 → ₹63.5), loading extra; separate (higher) rate quoted for 12mm (coil-cut) vs 8–10mm plate due to extra processing cost; validity/urgency used to push quick confirmation.
- **Standard commercial terms repeated across calls**: "+GST, loading, transport extra" is the default template; transport ~₹1200/ton cited once (min 10–14 ton loads); payment/handling charge standard **₹200** (disputed when billed ₹250); quotation **validity typically ~2 days**; credit period when offered = **1 month**; coil-cut / custom-length plates attract **no bulk cutting for flats** ("Flats-laam namma cut pandradhu kidayathu") while angles can be cut for a per-ton surcharge (~₹5/ton).
